subject: general
question: Which of the following is a heterotrophic organism?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Tiger**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A heterotroph is an organism that** feeds on another organism or plants for nutrients**.
 
• Heterotrophs can be further divided as,
 
 
• Omnivorous
 
• Herbivorous 
 
• Carnivorous
 
 
 
• Depend on the food type they eat i.e. they are liable on plant- or animal-based foods.
 
• Tiger is a **heterotroph** as it** feeds **on other animals and** cannot produce** its own food.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Autotrophs are the opposite of heterotrophs as they can produce their own food using light, water, carbon dioxide and other chemicals.
 
• Algae and plants are autotrophs as they can prepare their own food.
 
• Neem tree, Algae and Grass are autotrophic organism.
